{{Quote|Welcome to the office of Lieutenant Major Pirrell. I am ODX-9. How may I be of assistance?|ODX-9|<ref name="SWTOR" />}}
'''ODX-9''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] used by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="SWTOR" /> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> ODX-9 was stationed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], where they were assigned to the office of Lieutenant Major [[Pirrell]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
ODX-9 appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Bounty Hunter class mission on Balmorra.<ref name="SWTOR" />
